pages.title: Decision pathways
pages.description: Primary strategic call: reject categorical guesswork and run a parallel Two-Track Audit — test an early creditworthy extension against a pre-2029 §1031 exit (before the tenant’s $432.3M debt wall and 2030–2035 lease cliff). Exact dominance shifts cleanly by verified document gates below.
pages.caption: Strategic pathways: Wealth preservation vs. upside optionality

cells: Track 1A · Extend early then sell (§1031)
Corporate/strong-franchisee signs ≥10-yr extension at ≤5% rent cut with minimal TI, materially widening the 1031 buyer pool.
Requires ≥35–40 bps cap compression at 7%–8% cap to offset a 5% rent cut; guard against ≥35-yr Prop 13 trigger.
Track 1B · Sell pre-expiry via §1031 (Base Floor)
4–9 yrs remain ahead of JIB’s Aug 2029 $432.3M debt wall and 150–200 closures; preserves remaining-WALT pricing and defers Fed+CA tax.
Strict 45/180-day exchange deadlines; price strictly outside City of LA $5.40M–$5.63M and $10.90M–$11.07M ULA dead zones.
Track 2A · Negotiate & hold long-term extension
Executed lease carries corporate master guaranty, store sales >$1.87M AUV, below-market rent, and inflation escalators.
Retains single-tenant QSR concentration, $20/hr + 20.3% energy margin risk, and 2028 FAIR Plan sunset exposure.
Track 2B · Hold as-is toward 2030 / 2035 expiry
Only if remaining term runs to 2035 with strong unit sales OR underlying transit/CHIP land value already exceeds capitalized rent.
At 6.86%–7.86% discount rates (UST+200–300 bps), a 4-yr hold vs. 14.0 R net sale requires ≥13.8 R–14.5 R Year-4 terminal value.
Option C · Re-tenant dark box
Drive-through CUP stays intact and replacement tenant rent covers 12–24 months downtime, TI/LC, and Prop 13 reset.
Permitting/LADBS Ord. 183893 retrofit surprises and multi-quarter dark carry if JIB vacates at expiry.
Option D · Ground lease / CHIP infill redevelopment
Parcel qualifies for MIIP/AHIP/Metro D Line density where residual land value demonstrably exceeds capitalized QSR income.
Long entitlement/construction timeline, high debt cost (4.86% 10Y UST floor), and equity concentration.
Option E · Unshielded taxable cash sale
Appropriate only with near-market stepped-up basis or an overriding personal liquidity requirement.
Crystallizes federal 0/15/20% LTCG + 25% §1250 recapture + NIIT + California ordinary-income tax (FTB).

2 · Legal tenant & store P&L
Verify Jack in the Box Inc. corporate master lease vs franchisee LLC, plus store sales vs $1,874k brand AUV.
Franchisee-only shell or weak unit coverage elevates 2029–2030 closure/rent-cut risk.
3 · Broker price bracket vs Measure ULA
Confirm City of LA vs adjacent jurisdiction and net proceeds after 0.56% / 4.56% / 6.06% transfer taxes.
Avoid gross sale prices inside $5.40M–$5.63M or $10.90M–$11.07M dead zones.
4 · ZIMAS zoning, CHIP & D Line proximity
Pull ZIMAS C2/TOC/MIIP/AHIP tier and confirm LADBS Ord. 183893 retrofit status.
High infill land residual supports holding for land play instead of selling purely on QSR WALT.
5 · CPA basis & debt prepayment schedule
Compute adjusted tax basis, §1250 depreciation recapture, and current mortgage terms vs 7.62% corporate debt cost.
Low basis strongly favors §1031 exchange over taxable sale; free-and-clear simplifies timing.
